subject: Social Media
title: Meme Death and Overuse
description: A quick, practical guide to Meme Death and Overuse.

hook.text: A meme peaks on Monday. By Friday, your boss uses it. By Sunday, it's dead. Overuse kills memes.

buildup.text: Every meme has a lifecycle: niche creation, mass adoption, corporate co-option, and death.

discovery.text: Brands kill memes fastest. When a meme appears in an ad, its coolness evaporates instantly.

twist.text: Some memes resist death through ironic reuse. Using a 'dead' meme becomes its own meta-joke.

climax.text: Meme culture accelerates. What once lasted months now burns through its lifecycle in days.

punchline.text: The internet creates and kills at the same speed.

quiz.question: What typically kills a meme fastest?
